structured_output.summary: Staff-level backend engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems and workflow orchestration across defense, finance, and enterprise domains. Architected service-oriented systems using message buses and task distribution patterns similar to durable execution models; led distributed system integrations spanning hundreds of nodes. Proven track record designing resilient architectures, leading cross-site teams, and driving organizational adoption of distributed systems patterns.

bullets.text: Learned Go and deployed a prototype service to GCP as part of an internal learning cohort, including Go testing and fuzzing
Diagnosed and eliminated lock contention bottlenecks in distributed services using Splunk and Dynatrace, reducing p99 latency from ~10 seconds to milliseconds
Decomposed legacy monoliths into approximately 5 microservices for Edward Jones, deployed to AWS with Kubernetes orchestration
Owned Trip Trading and Give Away functions end-to-end for Southwest Airlines crew scheduling decomposition following the December 2022 crisis, integrating with crew bidding systems
Owned approximately 6 Spring Boot microservices for the Navigator passenger app, deployed across 8 ships and AWS shore-side services with ship-to-shore data synchronization
Reduced API response times approximately 10x (from several seconds to under 500ms) by separating historical and future cruise data endpoints and loading past data asynchronously
Built end-to-end test harnesses and improved local development environment to support running 5 distributed services locally, benefiting all 8 service engineers on the team
Owned deployment to ships and shore using Jenkins, Harness, and a homegrown feature flag system with zero incidents during tenure
Integrated VR-Forces CGF simulation with Apache Kafka via C++ plugins, forwarding live simulation data to Dockerized services for analysis and trainee scoring across distributed environments

Led a team of 3 engineers as architect for the Intelligent After Action Review (IAAR) tool across the full SDLC, integrating a GIFT rules engine with PostgreSQL and automated PowerPoint report generation
Modernized CCTT hardware I/O by replacing a mid-90s bespoke system with off-the-shelf WAGO hardware across 100+ simulators at 6 training sites, porting all Ada 95 logic
Integrated a proprietary blockchain ledger platform into RBC applications as a customer loyalty ledger, wrapping it in a Spring Boot microservice layer with OpenAPI-designed REST API
Built Android and iOS SDKs integrating with loyalty services; integrated into RBC's mobile app for a pilot deployment to approximately 1,000 users
Architected a service-oriented distributed simulation for the UK Army Scout vehicle using RTI Connext DDS as the real-time communications bus, leading a team of 5 engineers across Orlando and the UK

Led development of the Instructor/Operator Station simulation control product for F-16 and F-35 trainers, leading 7 engineers across 2 locations; implemented Agile processes, CI/CD pipelines, and deployed to 3 flight simulations
Software lead for WARSIM; rearchitected C2 reporting from a single feed to three live situational awareness feeds to GCCS-J, enabling the first joint training events with Army, Navy, and Air Force

Software lead for C2 on SE Core; built the C2 common vehicular component for AVCATT, integrating the C4I Adapter gateway with MCS and BFT tactical systems for the first time, leading a team of 3 engineers
Developed, tested, and integrated OneSAF distributed simulation with multiple Army C2 systems including FBCB2, AFATDS, and BCS3
Led the effort to rehost the CCTT distributed simulation from IBM AIX to Linux PCs, including endianness conversion and network packet debugging across multiple concurrent workstreams

Developed simulation code in Ada for the CCTT manned modules, a distributed virtual simulation with 20-40 manned simulators per site plus dozens of additional nodes, using DIS protocol and TCP/IP networking
Took ownership of the C4I Adapter, a Java network gateway translating between simulation communications and tactical C2 protocols, driving its integration into training simulations
